notes.title: Patch 2.0.7 coming!
notes.notes:
Even though we're busy with our newly released game (if you haven't played it yet, what are you waiting for?), we keep on improving Line Simulator thanks to your feedback! 

----------------------
Line Simulator v2.0.7 changes

BUG FIXES

- On the mobile, it now says "Wine" with the wine and "Beer" with the beer. 
- The last spot in the queue is turned off until you finish putting everything in the basket.
- Corrected a typo in one of the posters.

notes.title: Yes, another update!
notes.notes:
Hello again! 
Another week, another update. This time we have refined and fixed some audio bugs and other features. 
We hope you enjoy it!

____

Line Simulator v2.0.5 changes

- The cafeteria furniture has been redone.
- Entrance to rabbit hole 2 fixed
- Bug with the duck in rabbit hole 1 fixed.
- Fridge door fixed
- Removed duck prize furniture in the supermarket.
- Soundtrack manager bug fixes

notes.title: Line Simulator v2.0.2 - Fix changelog
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are constantly improving and refining Line Simulator to make the experience crazy fun for everyone. 
These are the changes we have worked on during this last patch:

Line Simulator v2.0.2
- The luggage slot has been relocated, now is easier to see and manipulate.
- The phone alarm now shuts down when you grab it.
- The teleport points now are always visible.
- The teleport points colliders that detect if you entered inside have been increased.
- Completed quests now appears in orange on the phone
- The background city of Level 1 has been rebuilt.
- Fixed some Level 1 objects' behavior.
- Fixed transparency on some Level 1 objects.
- Some life added to Level 1 city.
- Fixed phone's behavior when grabbing it.
- Fixes on level 2 scenario.
- Fixes on Duckwoman animations and behavior.
- Fixed a bug that altered significantly the pitch of some shopkeepers from the convention.
- Soundtrack remake.

Remember that you can join our discord and follow us on Twitter to keep up to date with the latest news.

Thanks for your infinite support and patience!

notes.title: Line Simulator finally has a great update!
notes.notes:
Finally, the day has arrived! 

After countless battles against bugs that cost us time, money, and many pizzas, Line Simulator finally has a great update!

It's been a long road to get here, and it's been a big challenge as our first development, but we appreciate you for sticking it out with us. Making a queue waiting game only works if there are people who can queue, so we knew we had to build a huge environment full of NPC's with their own life lives in order to give movement and energy to the game.

It has not been easy to balance and develop this for our team, but we have finally achieved it and we want to give you, the players, a sample of what we can really do as creators, trying our best and putting all the love and care into making this a good game that makes the player laugh.
You can check the changelog of fixes in the community hub, and don't forget to join our discord!

We would like to thank our entire community for supporting us along the way and patiently waiting for the game to be ready

We wouldn't be here without your support and feedback to improve ourselves as people and studio.
Thank you so much for supporting us and we hope you enjoy Line Simulator in all its glory!!

notes.title: Major Overhaul Patch Coming To Line Simulator!
notes.notes:
You asked, gave feedback, and we listened; we're going to be coming out with a major overhaul patch that fixes headset compatibility, glitches, bugs, animations, voiceovers, it's all getting a major overhaul, we haven't forgotten about you!

Within the month the first patch will be released with the second content patch coming out. All free, all for you!

Stay awesome, be sure to join our Discord, and let's keep waiting and show the world that it can be great again!

<3 Team Stracos

notes.title: Line Simulator Demo — Imminent Demo Release
notes.notes:
We want to improve our user experience with your feedback!

Some things that would really help us are as follows:

 Try out our demo and give us your feedback and criticism
 Write up and publish how you felt about our Demo experience (Don't forget to share it with us to be featured on the Media page of our website once it goes live this week!)
 Live stream your gameplay! (Again, let us know when you do this so we can grab some popcorn and pull up a front row seat for the show. If the video is saved, we'll also feature this on our Media page!)
 Play our game and reach out with any questions or comments you'd like our Creative and/or Development teams to address.
 Join our new Discord Community (and invite your friends!) to join in the daily discourse. You'll also receive live updates straight from our team!
 Feel free to check out and post to our Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, or LinkedIn!

For our team here at Stracos, Line Simulator isn't just a game. It's an act of defiance. We're a small collective of talent and brilliance that was told we would never make it in this industry.

Our response? No way, Jose!

We self fund under the Stracos umbrella as a boutique venture investment and technology consultative firm and pour our passion and drive into video game and AI/VR/AR solution design and implementation. We have never done this before, so we're leaving it up to passionate gamers like you to help us. This team is willing to fail until we get this right, and Line Simulator is the first in a long line of passion projects we plan to launch and update over the next decade.

Will you be the next page in our success story? We hope so.
